messages.subject: Lunch & Learn: 2025 changes to the National Security and Investment Act
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

The corporate team is running a CLE lunch-and-learn on recent NSIA developments and what they mean for M&A clearances, Thursday 2 October, 12:30-13:30, Room 4. Sandwiches provided. Please RSVP to me.

Donna
